author: Tyson Scadden
changelog: 1.0.1: fixes the client id fetch failing with 'RegExp.prototype.exec: too large' — the id is now found by scanning small windows of SoundCloud's pages instead of running a pattern over the whole multi-megabyte bundles.
description: Plays songs from SoundCloud. Search adds SoundCloud results for songs that also exist in the catalog, and playback streams the full SoundCloud audio, never a 30-second preview: preview-only songs are refused, not clipped. Downloads only when SoundCloud offers a real file, which is rare. It uses the SoundCloud website's own public client id, fetched by itself.
name: SoundCloud for Scadify

welcome.message: SoundCloud is now one of your sources: search shows SoundCloud results, and songs play streamed from SoundCloud in full. Preview-only songs are refused, never clipped.
steps: Put this extension in your audio source order (Settings, Playback) where you want it.
Search for a song: results it can play from SoundCloud appear under a SoundCloud heading.
